notes.title: Bosses and Chest Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone again, I am here again with a few new features in this update.

First of all, bosses will appear at certain stages of the game. Bosses are stronger and bigger than other monsters. And when bosses die, they give more score points and drop them from newly added chests. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44722302/2b437776f82ece9018e84a69a8de38e8021088b8.png

Secondly, as I mentioned before, a chest was added to the game. Gold, pets and swords can be found in this chest. These chests drop from bosses and you can buy them for gold from the main menu if you wish.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44722302/4b9fc8b0d8de838662f047fc5d8490076de1e147.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44722302/fbffee5ee9575bf061c16299720d99bb7a87cb6c.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44722302/acd153661bc63b82c9ab6eeb72e0ed7d58114845.png

Gold spawns encountered in the late stages of the game have been fixed, they now spawn more regularly.

The 2nd map now opens with highscore and you can now see your highscore from the main menu.

notes.title: New Map Update
notes.notes:
Greetings, adventurers! We're thrilled to introduce some exciting new features and enhancements in this latest update. Here's what's new:

Notifications: Now, receive alerts when discovering new swords or pets during your adventures!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44722302/b4bb1d4d0a94b9260fae3ce1c7d4585290faf358.png

Difficulty Modes: Choose from three distinct difficulty levels - Easy, Normal, and Hard. The challenge awaits, tailored to your preference!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44722302/88977ec201e012451c089d6ac467c13437a77bb6.png

Increased Rewards: With higher difficulty levels, enjoy boosted drop rates for gold, pets, swords, and health potions. Embrace the challenge and reap the rewards!

Expanded World: Explore the newly unlocked second map and fearsome creatures!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44722302/910a56c5b63bc987bd610f24c2c56c554b0605fb.png

New Monsters: Encounter a variety of formidable foes in the expanded world, each with unique abilities and challenges.

We hope these additions enhance your gaming experience and bring new excitement to your adventures. Thank you for your continued support, and happy questing!

notes.title: Slice It Down Regular Update
notes.notes:
Bomb ability, which was a buggy ability, has been reworked.
Damage to enemies is now dealt randomly within a certain range.
Old enemies have been increased and their difficulty has been adjusted.
Upgrade cost has been rearranged.
